Option Explicit
Dim s,p,n,t,f,log
Set s=GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2")
Set f=CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
t=Timer
Do
n=0
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name='Spitfire.exe'")
n=n+1
Next
If n=0 Or Timer-t>10 Then Exit Do
WScript.Sleep 200
Loop
Set log=f.CreateTextFile("C:\SPF_USB_VALIDATION\verified-original-exit.txt",True)
log.WriteLine "Read-only delayed WMI verification: original_process_count=" & n
log.WriteLine "No original launch, termination, key or mouse input in this verification."
log.Close
WScript.Quit n
